
func TestRecvMMsgKernelShutdown(t *testing.T) {
	fds, err := unix.Socketpair(unix.AF_UNIX, unix.SOCK_SEQPACKET|unix.SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer unix.Close(fds[0])
	if err := unix.Close(fds[1]); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	link, err := newRecvMMsgDispatcher(fds[0], &endpoint{}, &Options{ProcessorsPerChannel: 1})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer link.close()
	defer link.release()
	d := link.(*recvMMsgDispatcher)
	for i := range d.msgHdrs {
		iovs := d.bufs[i].nextIovecs()
		d.msgHdrs[i].Msg.Iov = &iovs[0]
		d.msgHdrs[i].Msg.SetIovlen(len(iovs))
		d.msgHdrs[i].Len = 999
	}
	n, _, errno := unix.Syscall6(unix.SYS_RECVMMSG, uintptr(fds[0]), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&d.msgHdrs[0])), uintptr(len(d.msgHdrs)), unix.MSG_DONTWAIT, 0, 0)
	if errno != 0 || n != uintptr(len(d.msgHdrs)) {
		t.Fatalf("closed-peer recvmmsg = (%d, %v)", n, errno)
	}
	for _, msg := range d.msgHdrs {
		if msg.Len != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("closed-peer recvmmsg returned length %d", msg.Len)
		}
	}
	t.Logf("closed-peer recvmmsg returned %d records of zero bytes", n)
}
